metadata.title: Vibrant Soul Portrait with Stacked Geometric Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy composition featuring a joyful close-up portrait balanced against a massive, vertically stacked block of ultra-condensed geometric typography in primary colors.
excludeWhen: minimalist designs with lots of white space

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition where the left half is occupied by a warm-toned, expressive portrait of a person laughing or singing, and the right half is dominated by a dense, vertically oriented typographic stack using bold, primary-colored geometric sans-serifs.
coreVisualRelationships: Balance between organic human expression and rigid geometric type
Vertical alignment of text blocks creating a heavy right-side anchor
Color coordination between the subject's clothing and the typographic accents
coreInvariants: Primary color palette (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow)
Subject looking upward and away from the text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the lower-left quadrant, scaled to fill approximately 40% of the frame, angled diagonally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive, two-tier stacked text block on the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's open mouth/expression, follows their gaze upward, then moves across to the top-right text and down through the vertical stack.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is a flat, neutral off-white that serves as a stage for the high-contrast elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Forest green for the largest text blocks
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red, yellow, and blue for secondary text and internal letter fills
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphics contrasts with the natural, warm skin tones and earthy patterns of the subject.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to primary red, blue, yellow, and a deep green

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
Rounded terminals on specific characters like 'O' and 'U'
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' characters are elongated ovals with contrasting color fills

treatment.fill: solid green with internal color fills

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, wide sans-serif for the top name line paired with an ultra-condensed version for the main title.
graphicDevices: Horizontal color bars separating text lines
Internal color fills for letter counters

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure
Matches the geometric, narrow aesthetic of the 80s

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a joyful portrait of a soul singer in a patterned warm-toned shirt, laughing with eyes closed, positioned on the left side of a square frame against a plain off-white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two levels of text on the right. Top level: a name in bold blue sans-serif above a red horizontal bar. Bottom level: a large two-word title in ultra-condensed green sans-serif, stacked vertically, with the 'O' counters filled with yellow and red respectively.

verificationChecks: Is the text vertically stacked on the right?
Is the subject's expression joyful and expressive?
Are primary colors (red, blue, yellow) used as accents?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's face
Check that the green text is the most prominent visual element
Verify the off-white background is consistent and clean
recipe.reuseFormula: Joyful Portrait + Ultra-Condensed Stacked Type + Primary Color Accents = Retro Soul Aesthetic
